resolved_findings.suggested_fix: Track whether the draft was started as an edit and retain its source rule identity/version. Clear or reject an edit draft if that source disappears during reset/plan restoration; reconcile external enabled changes when saving instead of replacing the entire current rule with the stale snapshot. Add regression coverage for edit→disable→save and edit→reset/load-plan→save.
resolved_findings.title: Invalidate research drafts when their source rule changes
resolved_findings.why_it_matters: An open research editor can silently restore an obsolete condition after Reset All or loading another saved plan. Workbench stays mounted while navigating, so its draft survives; when the original rule ID disappears, Save appends the old draft into the replacement rules. Editing a rule and then disabling its visible checkbox also saves the draft's old enabled=true value back over the checkbox change. Track the source rule separately and invalidate or reconcile that draft when its live rule changes, rather than treating a missing edited rule as a newly created one.
